stock.description: Folangsi Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive on-site logistics equipment solutions across China. The company's offerings span several key areas: providing intralogistics machinery via subscription, delivering extensive maintenance and repair services, selling both new intralogistics equipment and spare parts, and supplying an intelligent platform for asset and operational oversight. Their range of intralogistics machinery prominently features counterbalanced, reach, and warehouse forklifts. Founded in 2007, Folangsi has its primary base of operations in Guangzhou, China.
